description: Create and manage dynamic QR codes, update printed-code destinations, compare scan analytics, render QR images, and check current link reachability.

notes: Public tools include limited anonymous QR creation, public link checking, and routing simulation. Show the returned claim_url after anonymous creation.
Private account tools require a scoped QRtracer API key in the Authorization: Bearer header and enforce the connected account's existing plan and ownership permissions.
OAuth is a controlled pilot; general setup uses the public endpoint or a bearer API key.
Submitted by the QRtracer owner. Public documentation and llms.txt returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-05.
Link checking reports current reachability and general provider policy, not guaranteed expiry or destination safety.
